summary: National Rural Utilities Cooperative Finance Corporation filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement on October 16, 2026 for its Medium-Term Notes, Series D, offered directly to members and associates without agent discount or commission and continuously through agents on a reasonable-best-efforts basis. Notes mature nine months or more from issuance, with fixed-rate interest payable January 15 and July 15 and floating-rate terms set per pricing supplement; no sinking fund, optional redemption or holder repayment features possible. Notes are unlisted and specific price, rate and maturity await each pricing supplement. Routine shelf takedown; watch funding costs and member demand.
